card.name: Inside brand and drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through newly coined drug or brand names, especially monoclonal antibody suffixes like -kcqx and -ejfv, or the first letter of a brand name such as Nplate or nivolumab. It also fires on a few other spots inside multiword names.

modes.label: Antibody name endings
modes.description: The odd letter chunks that end a monoclonal antibody name, after a hyphen.

modes.label: Start of a drug name
modes.description: The first letter or two of a drug or brand name that is split into pieces.

card.writes: It suppresses formal Chinese and English phrasing and promotes casual words like things and stuff, so there is no clear link to drug names.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of an unusual drug or brand name that is broken into several pieces.
